message.content:
Oversized wool-blend tweed blazer in slate blue (#4A5D6E), structured shoulder cut, mid-thigh length, 100% virgin wool.  
Tailored wide-leg trousers in charcoal grey flannel (#2F3238), relaxed but tapered leg, full length, cotton-linen blend.  
Round-neck cashmere knit top in cream (#FFFDD0), soft drape silhouette, hip length, extra-fine merino cashmere.  
Chunky leather loafers in cognac brown (#965F3E), low block heel, padded sole, full-grain Italian leather.  
Delicate gold chain necklace with a single matte pearl pendant, adjustable length, sterling silver base.  
Slim rectangular sunglasses in tortoiseshell acetate (#D4B896), slight cat-eye shape, polarized lenses.  
Matte black clutch with a subtle textured weave, structured handle, genuine vegan leather.  

This outfit works because the oversized blazer adds a relaxed yet polished creative edge suitable for an autumn office environment without needing extra warmth at moderate temperatures. The neutral tones of the trousers and cream knit draw attention upward while quietly minimizing the appearance of the belly through balanced vertical lines. Textured fabrics like the tweed and flannel add visual interest that elevates the look beyond basic workwear, meeting the "neat" formality requirement with effortless style. The cognac leather accessories introduce a warm pop of color that grounds the cool slate and grey palette, completing a cohesive professional silhouette.
